name: io.github.ianderso/norway-archives-mcp
title: Norway Archives
description: Norway's church books, censuses and scans, National Library books, and place names.

environmentVariables.name: NORWAY_ARCHIVES_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk cache and the daily request count.

environmentVariables.name: NORWAY_ARCHIVES_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one request. Image downloads get 120 s to read.

environmentVariables.name: NORWAY_ARCHIVES_DA_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two Digitalarkivet requests. Never below 5.

environmentVariables.name: NORWAY_ARCHIVES_DA_DAILY_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Most live Digitalarkivet requests per UTC day. Cached answers are free.

environmentVariables.name: NORWAY_ARCHIVES_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so an archive can reach whoever runs the server.

environmentVariables.name: NORWAY_ARCHIVES_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: An existing folder. When set, the downloads save only inside it; needed to save under ~/Library, such as an iCloud Drive folder.
